note: Subject v2.1 (v2.0 only differs in ex1: v2.1 adds "You can use the name you want for each attribute"). The structure is checked for real: classes / methods the subject asks for, inheritance, super() in each subclass, show() of the subclasses, protected attributes, validation in the setters, static / class methods, nested stats class that really counts the calls. Source: authorized builtins, no import, type hints, PascalCase / snake_case naming, flake8, mypy.
